customers_say: Customers give positive feedback about the water purifier's appearance, taste, and TDS display feature. However, the reliability receives mixed reviews, with some reporting it works well while others say it completely stops working. Installation experiences are mixed, with some finding it quick while others report delays. Moreover, the value for money, service, and TDS monitoring aspects also receive mixed feedback, with some finding it worth the price while others regret their purchase, and some praising the display while others find it misleading.

reviews.title: Pure water
reviews.body: I have just bought the equipment. On first glance, built quality is ok. It comes with an RO FILTER which is not required for my area. Anyone buying online please check your TDS level of water before buying. I will update on the product once I fully use it. Presently I am rating it 4 star because after receiving the item even for 2day on one came for installation. I had to call customer care of Amazon and only then the process started. I lost 4days due to this.
